title: The Seed That Wouldn't Shine
moral: A small contribution can matter when everyone works together.

scenes.action: A storm cloud passes; one glow-seed remains dark.
dialogue: Maybe it needs a little sunshine.

scenes.action: Brindle builds a leaf reflector, but it slips into the water.
dialogue: My brilliant invention has become a boat.

scenes.action: Oakley finds the seed is buried under a tangled root; Morrow suggests asking the roots gently.
The friends combine reflected light, careful digging, and Tilli's wingbeat; the seed glows.
dialogue: And nobody had to be a superhero.

scenes.action: A new sprout unfurls; the friends celebrate as fireflies form a tiny crown.
